copy_rule: Copy every literal file and directory enumerated by the final artifact manifest, plus the original manifest and handoff, byte-exact. Do not rewrite original absolute execution paths or receipt bodies. Preserve actual-native including its original nested seals; native-evidence-copy-bindings.json maps original bodies.
timestamps_rule: Retain original scientific started_at/finished_at and all original inspection/execution timestamps. New evidence adoption/reinspection is a separate actual receipt, not a replacement original.
currentness_rule: Before save, freshly inspect all original 35 inputs and require exact descriptors plus git_revision/state. Any source input extension for durable adopted evidence must be explicit, with original capture and whole judgment fields preserved. Do not silently replace source input bodies.
save_authority: Root must approve the concrete guarded adoption and native-save bundle; this packet does not authorize or perform either.
